flags: PIN (>250 m): stored 38.76780,-123.52280 sits in forest NORTH of the Gualala River (the Mendocino County bank, ~350 m north of the Gualala Arts Center). The park page puts the campground on the Sonoma side, 'on the east side of Highway 1', with a trail that 'follows the Gualala River and skirts under the highway bridge' to the day-use side; the 2025 map (north to the right) has the river along the loop's west side. On imagery the campground access road leaves Hwy 1 just south of the bridge (day-use/extra-vehicle lot at ~38.7584,-123.5160) and enters the redwoods northward along the east bank of the river's north-south reach. The loop itself is canopy-blind; approximate target 38.7612,-123.5160 (confidence low, ~100 m). Stored -> target is ~0.9 km. Reviewer should confirm on another basemap before moving.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (value not changed): stored evidence 'satellite at 38.7650,-123.5197: ... ~130 m of unbroken redwood forest between the easternmost site and the Gualala River bank' was measured at 38.7650,-123.5197, which is the Gualala Arts Center building and parking lot on the Mendocino bank, not the campground. The county map draws sites 1-7, 10 and the walk-ins along the river.
